_description: Expected output schema for /app/results.json. All fields are required.

case_classification.<case_id>: <string: one of no_lesion | single_vessel_infarct | scattered_infarcts | mixed>

final_order: <team names sorted best to worst by mean combined rank>

mean_ranks.<team_name>: <float: mean combined rank across bootstrap iterations>

rank1_frequency.<team_name>: <float: fraction of iterations team achieved best combined rank>

<case_id>.ranking_change: <int: total rank displacement summed across all teams>
order: <team names in ranking order with this case excluded>

stability.most_influential_case: <case_id: case whose exclusion causes largest total displacement>
